status: USER APPROVED VFX DESIGN; NOT IMPLEMENTED; DEFERRED TO MASTER

motionApproval.historicalUserStatement: schvaluji analyzu, priprav detailni popisy pohybu a zacni animovat modely. U zakladnich obrancu zachovej stejny utok pro vsechny ranky.
motionApproval.implementationAuthorization: Prepare detailed motion specifications and begin animation work in separate working paths. Basic defender ranks I–VI share the same attack.
motionApproval.protectedOriginals: Approved basic defender V7 and champion V8 deliveries remain unchanged.

effects.look: Short ivory tip streak or thin blade crescent, then a small directional contact spark.
effects.trigger: Actual shot/contact and resolved outcome.
effects.limits: A ranged sword or lance gesture remains ranged. No long-lived slash field or bonus hit.

effects.look: A clear arrow or bolt with a fine warm-grey trail and brief nock glint. Poison arrows retain their physical shaft with a green tip.
effects.trigger: Existing shot, its progress and impact.
effects.limits: One rendered path per actual target; no permanent line or invented volley.

effects.look: A small faceted violet/cyan spell head, tapered trail and compact geometric impact burst.
effects.trigger: Existing spell shot and arrival.
effects.limits: Elven multishot is simultaneous target fan-out; it is not chain lightning.

effects.look: Ivory/gold focus at the actual staff, cross, palm or weapon endpoint; a small travelling spell and radiant impact.
effects.trigger: Existing Holy shot and resolved contact.
effects.limits: Holy is a defense class. Color does not add healing, resurrection or armor bypass.

effects.look: Amber angular glyph fragments leave the hammer focus; a compact forged projectile and broken-shield accent at the target.
effects.trigger: Engineer shot, actual shred state.
effects.limits: No floor hammer impact at the defender, new melee range or new ground shockwave damage.

effects.look: A visible bolt, bomb, stone or thrown canister leaves the approved release point; a local dust/shard burst at impact.
effects.trigger: Actual shot progress and impact; mechanism pose supplies only its release anchor.
effects.limits: Arc height is cosmetic; preserve shot lifetime. Local bomb sparks do not imply new splash or burn.

effects.look: A narrow bright core with 2–3 low-poly orange flame ribbons opens into a short tapered plume from inside the animated mouth; embers fade toward the affected area.
effects.trigger: Existing mouth pose plus active fire channel and visible eligible enemies. Aura-only sources use continuous aura state, not a new attack timer.
effects.limits: Breath is cosmetic. Never turn a circular aura into a directional damage cone, add damage ticks or gate damage by jaw opening.

effects.look: A sparse low orange heat veil near affected enemies and a few lifted embers, with no opaque floor carpet.
effects.trigger: Actual continuously applied burn-aura damage and current visibility.
effects.limits: Keep independent of ordinary shots and breath pulses. Do not pretend aura damage creates a lingering burn status.

effects.look: An angular electric line with a thin white core and blue outer glow. A small target-centred halo flashes for 0.06–0.10 combat seconds; total accent fades in 0.16–0.24 seconds.
effects.trigger: Actual primary electric shot, chain packet or fork packet and resolved outcome.
effects.limits: The local halo lights the area using a lightweight overlay/emissive effect, not full-screen flash. A failed hit has contact/block feedback, not a successful-damage flash.

effects.look: Render exactly the emitted enemy-to-enemy connections with short local flashes. Gold-white for Lady Claire, blue-white for Thunderbird.
effects.trigger: Actual chain events; retain packet from/to and order.
effects.limits: No invented hops, extra target, delayed damage or second body cast. Simultaneous simulation hops may receive a brief ordered reveal within the visual lifetime only.

effects.look: One origin with several simultaneously visible branching lightning paths to the actual fork targets.
effects.trigger: Actual fork proc paths; preserve source-to-target topology emitted by combat.
effects.limits: Visually distinct from a chain. Do not force targets through the primary victim or assume all configured targets were found.

effects.look: An icy faceted shard/ribbon and a small pale-blue impact mist, with Holy ivory in the core where appropriate.
effects.trigger: Actual frost shot and outcome.
effects.limits: A frost-colored hit does not prove freeze. The ordinary slow uses a separate restrained status cue.

effects.look: A pale-blue/ivory bead with a short crystalline ribbon between actual bounce endpoints. Each real contact briefly sheds 2–3 ice chips.
effects.trigger: Actual frost chain packets, including Angel allied-hit procs.
effects.limits: Do not use electric zigzags. Do not restart Angel body casting, add allies as enemies or invent a stun.

effects.look: A small translucent green cloud follows the infected enemy around the lower torso, with 2–4 sparse drifting motes. Keep its centre open so the silhouette stays readable.
effects.trigger: Post-resolution enemy.statuses.poison with active applications.
effects.limits: One cloud per enemy, not per poison stack/source. Density has a low cap. No spreading, root cage, immobilization or persistent floor puddle. Hidden enemies emit none.

effects.look: Short orange tongues and rising embers cling to the actually burning target; distinguish from green poison smoke.
effects.trigger: Active enemy.statuses.burn.
effects.limits: Track real expiry and immunity; do not attach to every fire-looking projectile or every heat-aura tick.

effects.look: Frost sources: a quiet broken cyan ring with a few ice grains. Ranger sources: thin teal wind bands around the lower body; flying targets receive bands at body altitude.
effects.trigger: Actual strongest effective slow, after immunity/boss rules and aura membership.
effects.limits: Never visually root a merely slowed enemy. One status treatment per target; freeze/petrify takes priority. Ground-only Frozen Celestial follows approved B03 when implemented.

effects.look: A short gold/white star loop above the head and a small impact burst for blunt sources; icy crystals only for genuinely frost-themed sources.
effects.trigger: Active freeze status used by the engine as a stun.
effects.limits: Do not apply icy appearance to every generic stun. Match actual duration/recovery; no added knockback or new animation timing.

effects.look: A low-intensity emerald eye/focus cue identifies an active Golem gaze. Only qualifying visible enemies accumulate a quiet mineral edge accent; actual petrification adds a removable stone shell and crack motes.
effects.trigger: Actual source.stoneGaze and per-enemy facing/petrify state.
effects.limits: No guaranteed petrification and no generic status immunity rule: preserve the explicit Golem exception. Do not replace approved body materials.

effects.look: A compact amber broken-shield glyph and a few outward metallic flakes; persistent reduction uses a restrained existing status segment.
effects.trigger: Actual strongest flat shred/aura contribution.
effects.limits: No model armor removal or additive aura graphics. Champion armor auras remain; MVP armor aura is removed by approved B01.

effects.look: A muted rose broken-cross marker with a thin interrupted ring near the target.
effects.trigger: Active healBlock status.
effects.limits: No heal-block symbol from poison alone. Do not show healing success while healing is blocked.

effects.look: A stronger directional gold-white impact wedge and up to 3 brighter chips, with optional existing critical indicator.
effects.trigger: Resolved effectiveDamage > 0 and confirmed critical result.
effects.limits: No pre-roll critical windup, extra projectile, camera shake or whole-screen white flash.

effects.look: Quiet recipient cues: cyan clock arcs for haste; amber blade notch for damage; mint arrowheads for range; ivory reticle for True Strike; lavender shield for control protection.
effects.trigger: Actual effective recipient support state; use existing support semantics.
effects.limits: Show source radius/links on inspection. No constant full-radius circles or one effect per duplicate support. Preserve the existing understandable symbols.

effects.look: A small gold-green mote acknowledges the source and keep-health display only after an actual heal.
effects.trigger: Confirmed recover event and real health increase.
effects.limits: Never fire on every poison hit or show +1 when the keep was already full.

effects.look: Magic immunity: amber angular ward; Physical immunity: cool violet broken blade; Refraction: actual charge sectors; Shell: compact grey impact plates; reactive armor: restrained plate accents following live stacks.
effects.trigger: Actual spawned variant fields, shield counts, block outcomes and reactiveStacks.
effects.limits: Do not infer abilities from name, color or geometry. Refraction recharge is distinct from HP recharge; Shell is distinct from immunity.

effects.look: Continuous regeneration: sparse green-gold motes only while effective healing occurs. HP Recharge: one cyan/green inward pulse at an actual successful recharge deadline.
effects.trigger: Positive HP gain attributable to regen/recharge, with healBlock and full HP respected.
effects.limits: Proposed read-only healing presentation record is needed to distinguish coincident damage/healing. Net frame HP alone is insufficient; no invented heal event exists today.

effects.look: Dread: a brief violet tether from the actual reaction source, then a small spiral on the affected defender. Disarm: a red broken-weapon sign on the actually disabled defender. Sapper: low dust/amber cracks on truly weakened ruins and affected defenders.
effects.trigger: Actual dread deadline, disarm window/protection and weakened state.
effects.limits: A locomotion or weapon flourish cannot cast any of these. Dread is a reaction to real owned damage, not mere proximity or reflected HP damage.

effects.look: Rush/haste: short backward red/amber motion accents; Blink: a compact departure/arrival fold, not a line across the skipped path; Evasion: a short side-edge wisp only on a real dodge.
effects.trigger: Actual active speed window, teleport event or evasion block outcome.
effects.limits: Keep route/gait authoritative. No per-frame footprints for flyers, no physical displacement on evasion and no extra movement ability.

effects.look: A small grey-violet cloak/reveal puff at a legitimately visible transition, using existing concealment rules.
effects.trigger: Authorized reveal/cloak transition and visible endpoints.
effects.limits: No clouds, chains, lights, status icons, tracks or death accents may reveal a concealed position. Flight over water needs no invented splash.

effects.look: Retain the personal MVP star/badge and inspectable own bonus. An optional quiet personal gold accent follows actual award only.
effects.trigger: Actual MVP award/current own level after approved B01.
effects.limits: No ally buff halo, armor-reduction aura, persistent support beam or MVP 10 damage pulse.

effects.look: Reserved subdued blue-grey focus with the offensive release suppressed.
effects.trigger: Only a nonzero enabled mechanic and actual active melancholy state.
effects.limits: DISABLED in current runtime: chance 0, duration 0. No new Melancholy effect or ability may be activated by this VFX proposal.

basic.name: Soldier
basic.approvedMotion: Compact forward thrust; spear at I and sword at II–VI use one identical normalized attack.
basic.anchor: Actual spear/sword tip; contact on the real melee outcome.
basic.note: One shared thrust for I–VI; no later-rank slash or shield bash.

basic.name: Archer
basic.approvedMotion: Compact repeating draw, release and return, including the same raised preparation at every rank.
basic.anchor: Actual bow nock at the common release.
basic.note: Same draw/release for I–VI; density is capped at high haste.

basic.name: Mage
basic.approvedMotion: Calm forward staff presentation with an unchanged supporting left arm.
basic.note: Magical cleave uses only real secondary targets, not a new ring of damage.

basic.name: Frost Warden
basic.approvedMotion: Defensive short staff push; faster VI preserves the exact family gesture.
basic.anchor: Actual staff focus at the short push.
basic.note: Physical hit with frost presentation; display slow rather than automatic freeze.

basic.name: Cleric
basic.approvedMotion: Gentle forward cross presentation, separate from the passive blessing aura.
basic.anchor: Cross or staff focus at the common presentation.
basic.note: Passive haste/detection remains independent; a blessing does not create healing.

basic.name: Druid
basic.approvedMotion: Short shallow inward-forward staff sweep with a small free-palm countergesture.
basic.anchor: Actual staff focus during its shallow sweep.
basic.note: Green thorn/spore projectile; replace misleading immobilizing root cage with poison cloud.

basic.name: Engineer
basic.approvedMotion: Short forceful hammer projection with a small downward finish; ranged runic bolt, not melee contact.
basic.anchor: Actual hammer focus at its short projection.
basic.note: Display name Engineer; ranged runic shot, not ground hammer melee.

basic.name: Stormcaller
basic.approvedMotion: Crisp right-palm lightning presentation with a brief recoil; one discharge for simultaneous selected targets.
basic.anchor: Actual right palm; existing book remains supported.
basic.note: Up to three current simultaneous primary target paths, not a new chain proc.

champions.approvedRelease: Anchor release to the existing shot event. Armor-breaking feedback appears at the confirmed impact; crown and regalia emit no independent attacks.

runtime.name: Elven Mage

champions.look: Violet/cyan focus-to-target spell fan for up to five real targets. Decorative crystals do not fire independently.

champions.look: An ivory-cyan crown focus emits up to ten real simultaneous spell paths, with restrained shared release glow.

champions.approvedRelease: No projectile or new impact exists. The current aura-attack presentation pulse may emphasize warmth without changing continuously applied damage.

champions.approvedRelease: There is no discrete release. Existing aura visual pulses can emphasize throat and chest while their original continuous application remains unchanged.

champions.look: A dark steel arrow with a muted blue-violet edge; flying-hit debuffs stay target-specific. Approved general slow aura uses teal wind bands, with no invented poison.

champions.name: Ranger Oathbreaker

champions.approvedRelease: Anchor ordinary release to the existing shot event. Fire splash appears only after its actual landed-hit proc and is not a second fire arrow.

runtime.name: Ranger Oathbreaker
runtime.referenceNote: Starší extrakt má jiné hodnoty Anti-Fly 2 a 100% magický zásah. Nekombinovat je do údajně přesného efektu wiki.
runtime.description: Top physical ranger with a strong anti-air slow and a chance of fire splash.
runtime.adaptationNote: Wiki Burned shorthand interpreted as 15% chance of 20x magical splash within four tiles; movement reduction capped at 75%.

champions.look: One strong physical arrow; only actual Burned proc creates a local orange radial burst over real victims. Instant fire splash is not a lingering burn status unless one exists. Approved aura uses teal wind bands.

champions.name: Fire Ballista
champions.approvedAction: Unload both limbs together in a crisp symmetrical snap, moving the nock forward through the center instead of twisting the entire bow frame.
champions.approvedRelease: Anchor departure to the existing shot event. Armor-breaking feedback remains a confirmed target impact, not another discharge from each decorative collar.

runtime.name: Fire Ballista

champions.look: A heavy bolt with a small ember tip leaves the nock; actual burn clings to the target, alongside a compact broken-shield accent.

champions.name: Golem

Proposed ordinary attack is arcane fan-out, not an extra chain ability.

Approved gesture is a staff/palm command; current damage is Magical, multishot 3. Use spell paths.
Dwarship
Current renderer presents a cannon toxic dart; motion specifies a hand throw.
Use the approved thrown-canister release. Poison is present, so infected targets receive cosmetic smoke. No new AOE poison.
Fire Ballista
Historical motion text says the Fire name adds no burning.
Current runtime explicitly has burnDps 120 / 3 seconds. Show actual burn.
Lady Claire
Motion analysis includes Melancholy cancellation.
Runtime chance and duration are both 0. Keep dormant support only, no activation.
Dragons
Some runtime prose mentions critical hits or evasion bypass.
No live critChance or trueStrike on these dragon profiles. Do not infer extra effects from prose or ID phoenix.
Angel / Archangel
Stable IDs archangel and dawnspire can be misleading.
archangel = Angel with allied-triggered frost bounces; dawnspire = sword-bearing Archangel.
Enemy variants
A shared base ID or Moon Clan name can obscure overrides.
Merge actual spawned variant over base. Blood-Leech Troll is regen, not stealth/disarm; Moon Scrapwings replace reactive armor with stealth plus evasion.
Legacy enemy archetypes
Some combat branches test enemy.type === sapper/shaman/berserker.
A campaign model field with that name does not activate the legacy type branch. Do not assign sapping, proximity haste or low-HP rage merely from model appearance.

requirements.title: Visual layer only
requirements.description: No change to damage, targets, timings, RNG, status durations, immunity, route or economy. B01–B06 remain a separate approved balance change.

requirements.title: Preserve approved assets
requirements.description: Keep V7/V8/V6 geometry, rig, materials, textures, palettes, source images, original prompts and motion originals byte-identical. Temporary external overlays are separately owned and removable.

requirements.title: Shared basic identity
requirements.description: I–VI share the approved family motion and VFX vocabulary. Rank may modestly raise clarity/detail within caps; never add extra attacks, beams or huge clouds.

requirements.title: Authoritative events
requirements.description: Animation describes preparation/release. Only actual shot, resolved damage, proc, current status and effective aura state create gameplay VFX.

requirements.title: Moving anchors
requirements.description: Use actual animated world-space mouth, palm, staff focus, bow nock, throwing hand/bowl or weapon tip; bind per model through verified metadata in new paths, not a guessed height offset.

requirements.title: No temporal distortion
requirements.description: Keep shot lifetime, progress, target and impact. Shortened animation recovery under haste cannot delay shots or stack new anticipations. One body release can accompany simultaneous multishot.

requirements.title: Separate channels
requirements.description: Persistent aura, direct attack, proc and target status are independent channels. One target with poison/burn/slow receives a bounded composite cue.

requirements.title: Correct target feedback
requirements.description: Blocked/evaded/immune hits can show appropriate contact/defense feedback, but no successful-damage flash or status cue unless the runtime effect exists. Generic impact alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Visibility
requirements.description: Respect actual reveal state for sources, targets, paths, lights, smoke, footprints and deaths. Hidden endpoints suppress the revealing path; no effect reveals a hidden enemy.

requirements.title: Ground and flight
requirements.description: Use target body altitude; ground-only effects follow B03 after integration. Poison smoke follows flying victims at body level; ground status rings never falsely attach them to the floor.

requirements.title: Readable color and shape
requirements.description: Poison = green smoke/drop; burn = orange tongues; electric = angular line; frost = pale shards; Holy = ivory/gold core. Use glyph/shape as well as color; retain established effect symbols.

requirements.title: Local flash only
requirements.description: Lightning briefly brightens a small area around actual targets. No camera shake, full-screen strobe, permanent bloom wash or point light for every projectile.

requirements.title: Quiet auras
requirements.description: Ordinary combat shows affected recipients and sparse source accents. Full support/slow/shred radii and source links appear on inspection; do not cover the map with circles.

requirements.title: Approved balance compatibility
requirements.description: No MVP ally/armor aura after B01. Preserve champion armor auras. Archdruid +1; Nature Spirit/Mother Nature +3. Ranger auras and Frozen Celestial ground targeting read actual integrated fields, never activate from this mapping alone.

requirements.title: Pause, speed and reduced motion
requirements.description: Use one combat clock with speed applied once. Pause freezes transient and persistent motion. Reduced motion removes flash/repeated wobble and uses static angular links/status glyphs without losing information.

requirements.title: Budgets and lifecycle
requirements.description: Pool and batch VFX; seed visual variation separately from gameplay RNG. Cap clouds by target and detail by screen space. Dispose on death, expiry, hide, reset and scene teardown; no stale source links.

requirements.title: Review in context
requirements.description: Preview isolated release/travel/hit/proc/status and crowded battles at iPad/desktop scale, both immunity variants, flying targets, pause, high haste and reduced motion. A preview must explicitly distinguish forced demonstration from actual proc probability.

requirements.title: Approval and execution boundary
requirements.description: The user explicitly approved B07 on 18 October 2026. Implementation remains deferred to Master verze hry; design approval does not authorize implementation in this chat or production deployment.

acceptance.description: One row for every one of 8 basic families, 38 champions and 54 enemy motion identities; 48 basic rank IDs remain linked.
Source approval analysis SHA-256 matches the approval receipt; preserve all approved original assets and source materials.
No gameplay RNG draw, damage/status call, target selection or clock change originates from presentation.
Every basic I/VI pair keeps the same gesture, source anchor identity and effect vocabulary.
Four dragon mouth plumes remain attached through jaw opening, turns, pause and reset; no throat clipping or chest-origin flame.
Aura-only Baby/Mother dragons keep circular continuous damage, including affected enemies outside the illustrative plume direction.
Direct dragon shots, ongoing heat and fork procs render independently without resetting each other.
Stormcaller multishot, Thunderbird chain, Lady Claire sequential chain and fork have the actual distinct graph topology.
Angel frost bounce is icy, can originate from the allied-hit proc, and does not restart the ordinary body cast.
A real poison application adds one green cloud; additional stacks modify bounded density only. Expiry removes it.
Poison blocked by immunity/shield/evasion creates no infection cloud; hidden infected targets reveal no smoke.
Dwarship local slow/heal-block victims are not automatically poisoned or damaged by the decorative burst.
Generic Catapult/Griffin stun uses star feedback; frost slow is not rendered as full immobilization.
Golem gaze requires the actual proc/facing state; petrification shell appears only on actual petrify, with the explicit immunity exception preserved.
Fire Ballista shows actual burn; Oathbreaker instant Burned splash creates no invented lingering burn.
No false dragon critical, fourth Elven Ranger arrow, seventh Elite Warrior arrow, Elven King siege bomb or active Claire Melancholy.
Runtime ranger auras and ground-only Frozen Celestial match separately integrated B03/B04; presentation never creates those mechanics.
No MVP ally or armor aura after B01; champion armor auras and strongest-only cues remain.
Archdruid +1 and Nature Spirit/Mother Nature +3 recipient range cues match actual effective state and do not sum.
All 62 current enemy spawn configurations select VFX from merged fields, including Moon Clan evasion, override removal and all three final-boss variants.
Host 31/35/36 Ashen and Spectral variants retain their actual opposite immunities. Host 38 knifer and troll have distinct stealth/disarm versus regen cues.
Refraction sector loss/recharge follows actual shields. HP recharge and regeneration show actual unblocked healing, never a false heal at full HP.
Dread follows real damage reaction, disarm follows active/protected windows, blink uses actual endpoints, and evasion does not move the actor.
Global pause, supported speed modes and reduced motion have deterministic seek/reset; no double speed multiplication.
Dense actual campaign scenes at iPad and desktop resolution stay within measured VFX budgets; effects leave target silhouettes, HP bars and route readable.
Reset, defeat, victory, scene teardown, cloak transitions and enemy death leave zero pooled ownership leaks or ghost effects; original one-shot death motion remains unchanged.
